# X² Lab — Xi Xie (谢希)

> Personal academic homepage of **Xi Xie (谢希)**, Associate Researcher at the College of Physics, Chengdu University of Technology. Research on optical skyrmions, structured light, topological photonics, optical tweezers and nanophotonics. 31 peer-reviewed papers including Nature Communications, Advanced Materials, Light: Science & Applications, Optica, eLight, Nano Letters and Photonics Research.

## Primary pages

- [About](https://xxlab.org/): biography, research interests, selected publications, research highlights and conference gallery
- [Publications](https://xxlab.org/publications/): complete peer-reviewed publication list with BibTeX, journal, volume and pages
- [Conference & Awards](https://xxlab.org/awards/): China invention patent, honors, invited and contributed conference presentations
- [CV](https://xxlab.org/cv/): education, research positions, funding, teaching and academic service
- [AI SKILL](https://xxlab.org/tools/ai_skills.html): prompts for academic writing and peer review

## Research topics

Optical skyrmions · structured light field manipulation · topological structured light ·
topological photonics · optical tweezers and optical manipulation · spin-orbit coupling of light ·
photonic spin Hall effect · metasurfaces · surface plasmon polaritons · Bloch surface waves ·
optical surface waves · nanophotonics

光学斯格明子 · 结构光场调控 · 拓扑结构光 · 拓扑光子学 · 光镊技术 · 光子自旋霍尔效应 ·
超构表面 · 表面等离激元 · 布洛赫表面波 · 纳米光子学

## Notes

- Site is bilingual (English / 简体中文); language is switched client-side on the same URL.
- Bilingual pages should be treated as the same document.
- Citation preference: please cite the journal version of record (DOI where available).
